Remember when he promised to lower energy costs on the campaign trail?

That’s far from the only promise he’s broken.

Trump repeatedly promised on the campaign trail to cap credit card interest rates at 10 percent.

But since he took office, Americans have paid nearly $240.7B in credit card interest — $134.5B more than what they would have paid under a 10 percent cap.

Like so many of his promises, it was another lie. piped.video/watch?v=vZwV58Dd…

Still wondering if inequality is out of control?

We are being reminded that a fundamental issue of our day isn’t the size of the government or how to make government more “efficient.”

It’s who our government actually works for.

Should it work mainly for big corporations and billionaires? Or should it work for the rest of us?

Donald Trump’s economic approval rating has fallen to a record low, according to a new Reuters/Ipsos poll.

Perhaps it's because he's running the U.S. economy like he ran his businesses — directly into the ground. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zbh9SW5Cgqg
Is it any wonder people feel the system is rigged?

According to the Cato Institute, The Trump administration is reportedly receiving millions of immigration applications, pocketing the hefty fees, and never processing the applications.

It’s collected over $1 billion in fees so far.

Where is the outcry over this fraud and abuse?

Not so marvelous news.

~95,000 scientists have left the federal government since the Trump regime took over.

Saudi Arabia reportedly wants Trump to launch a ground invasion of Iran.

Remember: Trump's family has deep business ties to Saudi Arabia, including new luxury properties in Riyadh and Jeddah.

Trump cannot be trusted to put protecting American lives over lining his own pockets.
Hello? www.nytimes.com/2026/03/24/u...

115 years ago today, dangerous working conditions sparked the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire, claiming the lives of nearly 150 workers.

Today, the Occupational Safety and Health Administration exists to prevent similar workplace tragedies — but Trump is gutting it at every turn.

The SEC's top enforcer just quit after Trump-appointed agency leaders pushed her to go easy on Trump's family and donors, including Elon Musk and crypto mogul Justin Sun.

Trump's inner circle is raking it in at your expense — and his cronies are letting them get away with it.

In 2024, Trump won the district of Palm Beach, Florida — home to his Mar-a-Lago resort — by 11 points.

Last night, Democrats won the district by 2.4 points in a state house special election.

Trump is so unpopular that he's losing his own backyard.

146 workers died in the Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire on this day in 1911. The bosses responsible were never held accountable for the awful working conditions that sparked the blaze. Remember this today as politicians and their corporate backers attack workplace safety.
We need to talk about this... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/trading-on-trump

Who knew what? When did they know it? How close were they to Trump's inner circle?

And can anyone within or around the orbit of this regime be trusted to put the interests of the American public above their own pocketbook?

It is maddening that we even need to ask these questions.

Trump is throttling renewable energy production, which can help guard against volatile oil price spikes.

Instead, he’s forcing companies to invest in dirty fossil fuels, whose prices are soaring due to his war on Iran.

Everyone loses under Trump — except Big Oil.

The Wall Street Journal — hardly an outpost of left-wing propaganda — reported yesterday on the results of an investigation conducted into Trump's weaponization of ICE.  

Here's what you should know (plus some additional thoughts)... https://robertreich.substack.com/p/a-report-you-need-to-read
It’s not about what this country can or can’t afford. It’s about priorities.
Democracy dies in billionaire hands.

Trump sent ICE agents to airports after refusing to go along with a deal that would have funded the TSA.

If you thought that was the only way Trump was making flying even more miserable, you'd be wrong. Watch.

Trump says that he will not approve TSA funding unless it's tied to passage of his voter suppression law, also known as the SAVE Act — or the SAVE Trump's Ass Act.

He knows that he and Republicans are doomed in the midterms, and the only way to combat that is to make it harder for people to vote.
Flying already sucks. It’s about to get a whole lot worse as Trump sends armed ICE agents to airports to deal with TSA shortages. But that’s not even the whole story. Watch.
Nexstar and Tegna’s merger was just given a special green light by Trump’s FCC. Never heard of these companies? Well, they could soon control your local news stations. Watch.
You might hear people say that protesting doesn’t make a difference. Leah Greenberg of Indivisible shares why that’s not true.

When 3.5% of a population actively participates in sustained, peaceful protest, it can topple authoritarian regimes — like the one currently in the Oval Office. We need 12 million people to show up on March 28 to get to 3.5%. Will you be one of them? Find out how at nokings.org
Trump is realizing he bit off more than he could chew by attacking Iran and unleashing global economic chaos.
Trump promised a cap on credit card rates. Instead, he delivered a giveaway to credit card companies at your expense. Former CFPB Director Rohit Chopra explains.
It’s fallen out of the news cycle, but Trump’s FBI and Justice Department are still covering up major details in the Epstein files.
The Pentagon was already one of the biggest culprits of waste, fraud, and abuse. Now we find out Pete Hegseth has been spending our money on steak and lobster?
E. Jean Carroll, one of my personal heroes, took on Trump and won. She’s one of the bravest people I’ve met. She shared some thoughts on Trump and Epstein’s awful friendship.
Today I want to tell you about my favorite sandwich, where to get it, and some other very important information you might not have heard before.
